searchText: Trying to wrap my head around why would someone configure two times the same builder url with a different auth data, what is the use case? Maybe connecting to a middleware (eg commit boost as url) and different auth data for each builder? yes this is how commit-boost works post-gloas, `url = cb.example.com` , `auth_data = builder.example.com` cross-posting from TG, but we put out a [guide](https://hackmd.io/@thUuBZa2ScW2i3kFbsrOFA/r1nXO072Me) on this for people to setup their hoodi validators with/without commit-boost
